name: Inth
long_description:
Inth brings together consent management, continuous privacy monitoring and AI-assisted investigation. It follows changes from code to production so engineering, marketing and legal teams can see what their sites and codebases are doing, verify their controls and get problems fixed.

We're the team behind c15t, our open-source (Apache-2.0) consent framework with millions of downloads, rebuilt in v3 to run on any framework and on the server. We also maintain an open library of privacy enforcement cases, and we've completed our SOC 2 Type 2 audit.

Backed by Y Combinator and Vercel. Start at inth.com
one_liner: Privacy and consent infrastructure that ships with your code

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Founder & CEO of Inth (YC P26). Building privacy and consent infrastructure that ships with your code. Creator of c15t, open-source consent for the modern web. Previously co-founded Everfund. Spoken at Next.js Conf, Jamstack Conf and AI Engineer World's Fair. Based in London.

launches.title: Inth: Dev-first cookie banners that don't slow your site
launches.tagline: Built for performance and full developer control.
launches.body:
tldr: your cookie banner is slowing down your site. Inth banners keep performance high, styled using your own components, and keeps you compliant using our open-source core, [c15t.com](http://c15t.com).

Inth is building cookie banners that don't cost your Core Web Vitals.

For years, cookie banners have plagued the internet with slow bloated scripts, that aren't aware of user locations or local laws, built for marketing and legal teams. Inth is fixing this with developer-first consent infrastructure.

<https://youtu.be/RJ7cSk1QYi8>

Inth helps developers automate cookie consent and user data rights to ensure compliance with all jurisdictions, using the fastest and most composable cookie banner available, c15t.

Bundled into your website's code, c15t cookie banners have native SDKs, i18n, and are fully customizable to match your UI and brand. Built for developers who care about compliance and performance.

Since Inth launched, c15t has grown over 2 million npm downloads, and is used by some of the top developer tools companies, luxury hotel chains, and online supermarkets.

Join the teams already using Inth to deploy faster, compliant websites at [inth.com](http://inth.com) or quickstart: npx @c15t/cli

Find our docs here: c15t.com/docs
